question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**picture**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **office**: a room, set of rooms, or building used as a place for commercial, professional, or bureaucratic work.
 
• **picture**: a painting or drawing.
 
• **tape**: a narrow strip of material, typically used to hold or fasten something.
 
• **child**: a young human being below the age of puberty or below the legal age of majority.
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**picture**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
 
• **Example**: *The **picture **__drawn by the artist was mesmerising for the viewers.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the banker found the **picture **which was drawn by the children as mentioned in the previous sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**The complete passage is: **A banker taped a picture, drawn by one of his small children, to his office wall. When he ***1. arrived*** at work the next morning, he found the ***2. picture ***was covered by a ***3. large*** notice, saying he was in ***4. violation*** of company policy which required personal items to be put away at night. ***5. such*** a reaction was not just petty, it risked demotivating the banker completely. In short, it defied common sense.
